# Draft:Characters of Clair Obscur: Expedition 33

Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 is a 2025 role-playing game by Sandfall Interactive, primarily set in an alternate version of France where the city of Lumiere would be removed from the Continent, where the majority of the game takes place. It centers on the titular Expedition 33, one of the many expeditions to kill the Paintress, a being who erases the citizens of the city of Lumiere by painting a number year by year, decreasing each time. The game follows Gustave, an anxious engineer and creator of the Lumina Converter who sets out apart of the Expedition after the gommage of his former love Sophie, Verso, a mysterious stranger and an immortal member of Expedition Zero, and Maelle, Gustave’s adopted sister with a mysterious connection to the nevrons of the continent. Other main characters include the mage Lune, the warrior Sciel, the mythical creature Esquie, and the gestral Monoco.
The story and characters were directed and created by Guillaume Broche and Jennifer Svedberg-Yen, while the characters and were primarily designed by the lead art director Nicholas Maxson-Francombe. Expedition 33 originated as a game called We Lost, but would eventually reboot development after Maxson-Francombe joined to appeal more to investors. Expedition 33’s cast has been generally well received with critics praising their emotional depth, and how their personal tragedies connect to the theme of the game. The game’s voice acting and motion capture has been well received, and has been nominated for multiple awards.
